name: @penguinharness/mce-rsi-toolkit
description: MCE RSI Toolkit: co-evolve a context-engineering Skill and the context it produces, select the context by validation score, then compare frozen baseline and final States.

penguin.description_zh: MCE RSI 工具包：同时进化上下文工程 Skill 与它产出的上下文，按验证得分选出上下文，再比较冻结的 baseline 与 final。
penguin.short_description: MCE RSI Toolkit: evolve the context-engineering Skill itself.
penguin.short_description_zh: MCE RSI 工具包：进化上下文工程 Skill 本身。

quick_start.prompt: Read mce-rsi-toolkit and run an MCE experiment on the selected Benchmarks with the requested model and budget.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 读取 mce-rsi-toolkit，按指定模型和预算，在选定的 Benchmark 上完成 MCE 实验。
